title: CheckDevice
description: supabase/functions/check-device/index.ts. PUBLIC endpoint, no auth required (called before an account exists, so there's no JWT to check yet) — auth here is intentionally absent, not an oversight. Lets the client check whether a device_hash already owns a free-tier account BEFORE attempting signup, so signup never creates an orphan user that then gets rejected by register-device. The device_hash is the client-computed SHA-256(hardware serial + persisted UUID) — see tables/profile-row.schema.json's device_id_hash field and SECURITY_AND_PRIVACY.md for the Windows-equivalent scheme needed.

available.description: True if no free-tier account currently owns this device_hash. false-y/absent count-mismatch defaults to true (fail-open on a DB error is NOT the behavior here — a db_error is returned as an explicit error instead, see error schema).
